verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions Slack, Notion, or Zapier integrations. What Fathom documents is a REST API, webhooks that POST meeting data to a URL, SDKs, an MCP server and CRM field sync. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not native delivery of notes into Slack channels, Notion pages or Zapier, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier
